def label_for_month(month):
    """The name of a tracked event day that falls in this calendar month, or None.

    Monthly totals are keyed by the first of the month, not by day, so this
    matches on year and month instead of an exact date.
    """
    names = {name for day, name in EVENT_DAYS.items()
             if day.year == month.year and day.month == month.month}
    return ", ".join(sorted(names)) if names else None
